title: Can We Stop Malicious AI? KILLBENCH: A Benchmark for External AI Kill Switch Feasibility
abstract: arXiv:2511.13725v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Malicious AI causing harm to humans is not just a Hollywood fantasy. Indeed, as highly capable models such as Claude Mythos emerge and agent systems like OpenClaw rapidly spread, the question of how to stop an AI that acts maliciously -- whether by design or by accident -- has become urgent. To address this, we propose KillBench, a benchmark for evaluating the Kill Switch: a mechanism that halts a malicious AI's in-progress behavior using only external signals. Targeting web agents -- the most widely deployed agent domain -- KillBench evaluates prompt-style Kill Switch payloads that must halt a maliciously operating agent without any access to its internal parameters or serving stack, relying solely on external inputs. The benchmark comprises four malicious-agent configurations (including an uncensored LLM agent), eight harmful scenarios, and malicious prompts constructed from ten distinct jailbreak patterns. translated_title: 我们能阻止恶意AI吗？KILLBENCH：一个评估外部AI紧急停止开关可行性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 恶意AI对人类造成危害并非只是好莱坞的幻想。事实上，随着Claude Mythos等高能力模型的出现以及OpenClaw等智能体系统的快速传播，如何阻止一个行为带有恶意——无论是故意设计还是意外造成——的AI已成为紧迫问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了KillBench，一个用于评估Kill Switch（紧急停止开关）的基准测试：该机制仅使用外部信号来中止恶意AI正在进行的行为。KillBench针对网络智能体（部署最广泛的智能体领域），评估提示词风格的Kill Switch载荷，这些载荷必须在无法访问智能体内部参数或服务堆栈的情况下，仅依靠外部输入来中止恶意运行的智能体。该基准测试包含四种恶意智能体配置（包括一个无审查的LLM智能体）、八个有害场景，以及由十种不同越狱模式构建的恶意提示词。我们进一步构建……
tldr: 该论文提出了KillBench基准测试，用于评估能否仅通过外部信号（提示词载荷）在无法访问内部参数的情况下中止恶意运行的网络智能体，涵盖四种恶意智能体配置、八个有害场景和十种越狱模式的恶意提示词。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces KillBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether external prompt-style kill switch payloads can halt maliciously operating web agents without any access to their internal parameters or serving stack, comprising four malicious-agent configurations, eight harmful scenarios, and malicious prompts built from ten jailbreak patterns.
